title: Static Frontend to React

assessment_snapshot.intro: The repository contains an employee leave-management dashboard with a separate Java API:
bullets: Frontend is static HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript in frontend/, built into the Spring Boot app's static resources.
Spring Boot 4.1.1 backend exposes employee and leave-request JSON endpoints; H2 persistence is configured.
The UI has CSS custom properties and responsive breakpoints in frontend/style.css; no screenshot or recording was attached.

proposed_outcome: Convert the existing leave-management frontend to React while retaining the current dashboard features and connecting to the existing API. Leave the Spring Boot backend and data layer unchanged unless the user specifies otherwise; confirm the target UI library, visual reference, success criteria, and where the rewritten frontend should live.
